summary_en: This phase 1 trial tests allogeneic adenovirus-specific cytotoxic T lymphocytes, a donor T cell therapy, in patients with a weakened immune system and adenovirus-related disease. The listed conditions include hematopoietic and lymphoid cell neoplasm. The therapy is given as an intravenous infusion over 30 minutes within two weeks of enrollment, and more infusions may be given at the investigator's discretion if there is no disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; the total number of infusions is not stated. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; the brief summary says the study looks at side effects and how well the therapy works.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 evalúa los linfocitos T citotóxicos específicos contra adenovirus de donante alogénico, una terapia con células T de donante, en pacientes con un sistema inmunitario debilitado y enfermedad relacionada con adenovirus. Las condiciones listadas incluyen neoplasia de células hematopoyéticas y linfoides. La terapia se administra como infusión intravenosa durante 30 minutos dentro de las dos semanas posteriores a la inscripción, y se pueden administrar más infusiones a criterio del investigador si no hay progresión de la enfermedad ni toxicidad inaceptable; el número total de infusiones no está indicado. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el resumen breve señala que el estudio analiza los efectos secundarios y qué tan bien funciona la terapia.
who_for: Patients age 1 year or older with asymptomatic adenovirus viremia, based on repeated or high-level quantifiable test results.
Patients age 1 year or older with probable or definitive adenoviral disease, as defined in the protocol appendix.
Written informed consent, or signed assent from patient, parent or guardian.
Willing to follow the study protocol requirements.
not_for: Taking prednisone above 0.1 mg/kg/day or equivalent at enrollment.
Received anti-thymocyte globulin within 14 days, or donor lymphocyte infusion or Campath within 28 days of enrollment.
Other uncontrolled infections, as defined in the criteria.
Active acute graft versus host disease, grade 2 or higher.
